description: A list of questions ? a syllabus, an exam, what the person needs answered ? onto the open questions in order (as=frontier, the default; the housekeeping's explorer works through them at night), or as research runs one each up to 10 (as=runs; the rest are filed as open questions). One question per line. Paths from the keeper only.

limit.description: How many questions to take (default all, up to 200).

path.description: The file on this machine (absolute path).

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

text.description: The questions, pasted, one per line.
